decisions.reason: Although it received less visible commitment than the dedicated-page lifts, temporary COVID-related demand disruption and some public mention make management likely to persist.
The dedicated page signals public commitment and the firm has invested in this specialized lift, so escalation of commitment favors keeping it despite unclear recent results.
